summary: Iteration 4 verification: (1) Router-refactor smoke passes — all 9 public endpoints (/, /markets, /events, /boat-pros, /posts, /reviews, /crew-positions, /crew-bank/open, /payments/packages) return 200. (2) Auth-gated endpoints correctly return 401/200 and admin gating returns 401/403/200 as expected. (3) WebSocket at /api/ws/{user_id}?token= rejects invalid tokens (403 upgrade) and accepts valid ones (101). (4) NEW is_race: POST /events with is_race:true stores + returns is_race=true; GET /events lists it; premium can join, free gets 402. (5) NEW Resend mailer hook: aggregator events (no organizer_email) do NOT log any [mailer] activity; community events with organizer_email fire the Emergent proxy — logs show 'HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted' and '[mailer] sent to=jenn@sailmorenow.com id=...' — no exceptions/5xx. (6) Prior iteration 3 (test_crew_bank_v3.py) and iteration 2 (test_events_aggregator_bugfix.py) tests still pass unchanged (4 skips are pre-existing admin-only tests requiring a different token). (7) Frontend modal glitch fix verified via Playwright: outer div class is 'fixed inset-0 z-[60] ...', inner scroll container class contains 'overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain flex-1 min-h-0', body.style.overflow='hidden' while open and restored on close, Escape closes the modal. (8) IS_RACE checkbox present on /events new-event form with data-testid='event-is-race' and label 'This is a race (enables Crew Bank)' — toggles correctly.

issues: datetime-local inputs use the browser's default date picker instead of a shadcn Calendar component — inconsistent UX with the rest of the app. Purely cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py refactor is clean (60 lines) and every router is properly prefixed under /api. Nice work.

community_router.py is now ~360 lines and still bundles posts + events + registrations + crew bank + aggregator-admin — consider splitting crew_bank into its own router file since it now has its own mailer side-effect and status endpoint.

deps.py: current_user_from_token silently returns None on any DB miss; consider structured logging on token-mismatch for debugging (currently only visible in tests when a request unexpectedly comes back 401).

_maybe_email_organizer creates a fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task without keeping a reference — if the event loop is shutting down mid-request the task will be logged as 'Task was destroyed but it is pending'. Consider storing the task on a background-tasks set or using FastAPI BackgroundTasks.
mailer.py: EMAIL_BASE_URL is intentionally hardcoded (per playbook) — that's fine but leave a comment tying it back to the playbook doc URL for future maintainers.
